New API OAuth provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness. It uses the host authorization and credential se
rvices for secret lifecycle and owns New API instances, account configuration, groups, token selecti
on, model discovery, and model routes.
The plugin contributes flat OAuth entries to the host Model Center through the public `modelEntryReg
istry` service and the keyed `settings.modelCenter.entry` Slot. It no longer creates a standalone Ne
w API settings section. Signed-in accounts are sibling entries of direct Base URL/API key providers
and retain their provider-specific group, token, discovery, protocol, and model-selection flow.
Only non-secret browser drafts such as site fields, model search, and wire protocol are stored with
scoped/versioned keys. OAuth credentials and New API tokens remain in host-owned credential/state st
orage and are never written to `localStorage`.
See README.zh-CN.md for configuration and protocol details.
